authorisation: Branch 2 of the frontier fork, authorised as a prospectively frozen successor. Specified and committed BEFORE any run.

WHAT_IS_SEALED_AND_MUST_NOT_BE_REOPENED.explicitly_not: theorem-level non-identifiability. That status belongs to the semantic twin alone, whose observables are IDENTICAL to the positive's.

ESTIMATOR_SPECIFICATION.1_target_quantity: the SAME donor-level linked-vs-control correspondence contrast as the current tournament. The estimand is not changed.
ESTIMATOR_SPECIFICATION.2a_depth_sensitivity_definition: per pair and donor, the correlation across metacells between the pair's RAW (pre-QC-residualisation) RNA signal and rna_depth, and likewise for ATAC and atac_depth. Computed pre-residualisation so the variable carries information rather than being ~0 by construction.
ESTIMATOR_SPECIFICATION.3_no_coarsened_bins: the primary estimator uses NO binning and NO trimming. All linked pairs are scored.
ESTIMATOR_SPECIFICATION.4_nuisance_fit_population: UNLINKED/CONTROL PAIRS ONLY. Linked pairs never enter the nuisance fit.
ESTIMATOR_SPECIFICATION.5_cross_fitting: by PROMOTER. K=5 folds over promoters. The nuisance model never predicts a promoter it was trained on.

7_hyperparameter.chosen: PROSPECTIVELY, before any run, on standardised features
7_hyperparameter.forbidden: any search against TECH, against any arm label, or against the gate outcome
7_hyperparameter.note: a fixed prospective value is used rather than internal per-fold selection, because a fixed value is auditable and cannot be accused of leaking arm structure through a selection loop

ESTIMATOR_SPECIFICATION.9_scoring: linked pairs scored from residuals at the DONOR level, preserving the existing seed and bootstrap machinery unchanged (donor is the independent unit; leave-one-donor-out folds averaged within seed; one-sided LCB95 bootstrapped over seeds).

QUALIFICATION_RULE_UNCHANGED.rule: every represented nuisance family must have one-sided LCB95 > M_MIN
forbidden: relaxing nuisance control to recover TECH (the no_anchor_matching trap)

MANDATORY_REPORTING__PROVE_THE_SUPPORT_P: fraction of all 960 linked pairs actually scored
effective sample size (Kish, on per-pair contributions)
worst nuisance imbalance between linked and control on the adjustment variables
residual correlation between the per-pair score and log-distance
residual correlation with degree, accessibility and anchor frequency
contribution concentration: share of the total carried by the top 1%, 5%, 10% of links

PREDECLARED_INTERPRETATION.A_TECH_clears_AND_broad_coverage_AND_oth: STRONG evidence that the problem was COARSE SUPPORT ADJUSTMENT, not intrinsic non-identifiability.
PREDECLARED_INTERPRETATION.B_TECH_clears_BUT_tiny_subset_or_weights: the SAME FAILURE DISGUISED as continuous adjustment. Not a pass.
PREDECLARED_INTERPRETATION.C_TECH_still_fails_despite_good_nuisance: STRONGER evidence that the current observables are insufficient. Then investigate IDENTIFIABILITY ITSELF - do not try estimator #2, #3, #4.
PREDECLARED_INTERPRETATION.D_another_family_breaks: STOP. Do not trade one nuisance failure for another, exactly as no_anchor_matching exposed.
PREDECLARED_INTERPRETATION.note: These four readings are fixed before the estimator runs. The result is classified into one of them; the classification is not negotiated afterwards.

SEALING.tournament_unchanged: arms, worlds, seeds, M_MIN, LCB construction and the held-out family are all inherited from tournament v2.1 without modification. ONLY the estimator changes.
